name: Metro 2055
storyline:
In the year 2055, humanity’s last remnants have retreated into the dark, suffocating depths of the subway systems following a global collapse triggered by war, economic ruin, and a devastating plague. You follow the story of Jack Harper, a weary scout who lost everything when his home station was destroyed. As Jack, you must navigate a treacherous underground society where the air is thin, and resources are thinner. The tunnels are far from empty; they are caught in a violent tug-of-war between factions like the ruthless "Family" and the idealistic "Communards," all while mutated horrors and scavengers lurk in the shadows of the abandoned tracks.

The narrative is driven by Jack’s search for meaning in a world that has seemingly ended, forcing you to make heavy moral choices that decide the fate of entire stations. Your journey takes you from the claustrophobic safety of fortified hubs to the lethal, irradiated ruins of the surface on desperate scavenging runs. Every mission—whether it’s investigating a gruesome murder or defending a settlement from a monster breach—shapes Jack’s reputation and determines if the flickering light of human civilization will finally go out or find a way to endure against the overwhelming darkness.
summary: Metro 2055 is a post-apocalyptic survival game set in the dark subway tunnels of a destroyed city. Explore the metro, face dangerous enemies, craft weapons and items, and prove your survival skills in extreme conditions. The game combines combat, stealth, and exploration in an immersive experience.
